title.zh: 一根指针，为什么能测三种量？
title.en: Why can one pointer measure three quantities?

question.zh: 一根指针，为什么能测三种量？
question.en: Why can one pointer measure three quantities?

description.zh: 打开多用电表的等效电路，跟随同一表头的分压、分流和内电池路径，再用真实加载解释灯不亮的故障。
description.en: Trace one head through series, shunt and internal-cell circuits, then use real meter loading to explain a dark lamp.

cues.title: 一个表头，怎样测电压？
cues.titleEn: One head: how does it measure voltage?
cues.caption: 串联电阻分担电压，表头仍只读小电流。
cues.captionEn: A series resistor limits head current.
cues.zh: 同一根指针，怎么能测三种量？它始终只响应表头电流。先把电表跨接灯泡。看表内：串联电阻分担大部分电压，只有很小的电压留给敏感表头。这里满偏只需五十微安。五伏挡把这个小电流换算成外部电压。若灯泡电压几乎不变，换到十伏挡，指针会怎样？先预测。串联电阻增大，电流和偏转约减半；按新量程读，电压几乎不变。
cues.en: How can one pointer measure three quantities? It always responds to current through its head. Connect the meter across the lamp. Inside, a series resistor takes most of the voltage, limiting head current. Full scale needs only fifty microamps. Now predict a change from five volts to the ten-volt range. The larger resistance reduces head current and deflection to about one half. Reading the new scale gives almost the same lamp voltage.

cues.title: 大电流怎样绕过表头？
cues.titleEn: How does large current bypass the head?
cues.caption: 总电流在表头与分流支路之间分配。
cues.captionEn: Total current splits between head and shunt.
cues.zh: 测电流，要把电表串入灯泡支路。但灯泡电流远大于表头的满偏电流，能全部挤过表头吗？看内部的并联岔路：低电阻支路分走绝大部分电流，表头只分到很小一份。两支路再汇合，总电流没有丢失。电表仍有小电阻，接入后会稍微改变电流。现在换到更小的零点一安量程，先预测。分流电阻增大，表头分到更多电流，这个电路会超量程。
cues.en: Insert the meter into the lamp branch. Can all that current pass through its sensitive head? Look at the parallel paths. A low-resistance shunt carries most of it; only a small share enters the head. The currents rejoin, so none is lost. The meter still adds a small resistance. Predict the smaller, zero-point-one-amp range. Its larger shunt resistance sends more current through the head, exceeding full scale in this circuit.

cues.title: 电阻测量的电流从哪来？
cues.titleEn: Where does resistance-test current come from?
cues.caption: 内电池驱动回路；短接时偏转最大。
cues.captionEn: The internal cell drives the test current.
cues.zh: 灯泡已经断电，欧姆挡为什么还有读数？电流来自表内电池。沿黑表笔、待测物、红表笔，再经过表内支路追踪闭合路径；这是本示例模拟表的极性。表笔分开，电流为零，指向无穷大；短接，电流最大，指向零欧姆。调零改变内部电阻，让同一表头恰好满偏。更换倍率后还要重新检查。待测物必须先与外部电源分离。
cues.en: Why can the ohms range work with external power disconnected? Its own battery supplies current. Follow this modeled meter’s black lead, specimen and red lead, then the internal return paths. Open probes mean no current and infinite resistance. Shorted probes give maximum current and zero ohms. Zero adjustment changes internal resistance until the same head reaches full scale. Recheck after changing range. The specimen must be isolated from external power.

cues.title: 为什么欧姆刻度不均匀？
cues.titleEn: Why is the ohm scale nonlinear?
cues.caption: 外部电阻与内阻共同决定表头电流。
cues.captionEn: External and internal resistance both matter.
cues.zh: 现在接入电阻。外部电阻等于内部等效电阻时，电流变成短接时的一半。把外部电阻再加倍，指针会再减半吗？先预测。总电阻只从两份变成三份，所以指针到三分之一，不是四分之一。这就是欧姆刻度不均匀的原因。换回四百七十欧姆，在乘十挡读四十七，再乘十。
cues.en: When external resistance equals internal resistance, current falls to half its short-circuit value. Double the external resistance: will the pointer fall to one quarter of full scale? Predict first. Total resistance grows from two parts to three, so deflection becomes one third, not one quarter. That makes the ohm scale nonlinear. Back at four hundred seventy ohms, the times-ten scale reads forty-seven.

cues.title: 灯丝也能测电阻
cues.caption: 冷态电阻不能代替正常发光时的电阻。
cues.captionEn: Cold resistance differs from hot resistance.
cues.zh: 换成一只没有接通外部电源的小灯泡。表内的小电流经过灯丝，仍能测到电阻，但它不会像正常工作时那样发光。这里得到的是冷态电阻，不能直接拿它代替灯泡发光、温度很高时的电阻。
cues.en: Replace the resistor with a lamp disconnected from external power. A small meter current passes through the filament and measures resistance without making it glow normally. This is cold resistance; it should not be substituted for the resistance of a hot, operating filament.

cues.title: 接触条件也重要
cues.caption: 同一条手部路径，接触条件改变读数。
cues.zh: 再观察手部接触的示意。两只手分别接触表笔，欧姆挡测到的是这条接触路径的等效电阻。接触面积、压力和皮肤状态都会影响结果。因此这不是一个人的固定常数。画面只用可调电阻表示这种差异，不用它判断健康状态。
cues.en: Now consider the hand-contact diagram. Each hand touches a probe, and the meter reads the equivalent resistance of that contact path. Area, pressure and skin conditions affect the result, so it is not a fixed personal constant. This diagram uses a variable resistor to represent that variation, not to assess health.

cues.title: 交换表笔，读数变了
cues.caption: 此表型的黑表笔为内部正极。
cues.captionEn: This model’s black lead is positive.
cues.zh: 换成二极管，先认清带色环的一端是阴极。这个模拟式欧姆挡的黑表笔接表内电源正极：黑接阳极，红接阴极，正向电流较大。交换表笔后，电流很小，指针靠近无穷大。二极管不是固定电阻，读数还会随表内电源和倍率变化，也不要把这种极性约定套到所有数字表上。
cues.en: The band marks the diode’s cathode. In this particular analog ohmmeter, the black lead is connected to the internal positive supply. Black on anode and red on cathode produces more forward current. Swap them, and very little current flows, moving the pointer toward infinity. A diode is not a fixed resistor: its apparent resistance depends on the meter and range. Other meters can use different polarity conventions.

cues.title: 灯不亮，先检查电源
cues.caption: 同样灯不亮，电池电压可能不同。
cues.captionEn: The same dark lamp can have different causes.
cues.zh: 现在是故障电路：开关已经闭合，灯却不亮。先用二点五伏电压挡跨接电池。电池耗尽时，读数接近零。换成有电但别处接触不良的情形，灯仍不亮，电池两端却有电压。相同现象，不一定有相同原因。
cues.en: The switch is closed, but the lamp is dark. Begin by probing the battery on the two-point-five-volt range. A depleted source reads near zero. With an energized battery and a bad contact elsewhere, the lamp stays dark but battery voltage remains. The same visible symptom can have different causes.

cues.title: 寻找异常电压降
cues.caption: 电表接入后，测量支路也通过电流。
cues.captionEn: The meter also loads the tested circuit.
cues.zh: 把表笔移到开关两端。正常闭合触点两端的电压很小；如果触点几乎断开，大部分电压反而落在这里。接着换成导线断路的情形，沿同样的电路路径检查导线两端。表笔移动改变的是测量位置，电表也已经参与了这个电路。
cues.en: Move the probes to the switch. A good closed contact has little voltage across it; a nearly open contact can carry most of the source voltage. Next consider a broken wire and test its two ends along the same circuit path. Moving the probes changes the measured section, and the voltmeter itself is part of the circuit.

cues.title: 有电压，仍可能不发光
cues.caption: 有电压，不保证有正常工作电流。
cues.captionEn: Voltage does not guarantee working current.
cues.zh: 最后换成灯座接触不良。检查开关，两端电压很小；把表笔移到灯座外侧，电压却接近电源电压，但灯仍不亮。题目限定的几个故障中，这支持灯座接触不良。真实维修还有灯丝断裂等其他可能，单凭这个读数不能把它们一概排除。
cues.en: Finally use a bad lamp-socket contact. The closed switch shows little voltage, but probing the outer socket terminals gives almost the source voltage while the lamp remains dark. Among the specified candidate faults, this supports a bad socket contact. In real diagnosis a broken filament and other possibilities remain; this reading alone cannot exclude them.

question.zh: 同一根指针怎样分别测电压、电流和电阻？
question.en: How can one pointer measure voltage, current and resistance?

lead.zh: 追踪表内三条不同路径，看同一个敏感表头怎样对应不同的外部量。
lead.en: Follow three internal circuits that connect the same sensitive head to different quantities.

principle.zh: 表头响应自身电流。串联电阻分担电压，并联电阻分走电流；欧姆挡用内电池和已知内阻把待测电阻变成电流。
principle.en: The head responds to its own current. A series resistor shares voltage, a shunt diverts current, and an internal cell makes resistance measurable through test current.

question.zh: 理想 3 V 电源不变，把 5 V 挡换成 10 V 挡，指针偏转和电压读数分别怎样变化？
question.en: An ideal source stays at 3 V. What happens to pointer deflection and the reading when the range changes from 5 V to 10 V?

explanation.zh: 输入电阻由 100 kΩ 变成 200 kΩ，表头电流从 30 µA 变成 15 µA，偏转由满量程的 60% 变成 30%；按新量程读仍是 3 V。实际电源还可能受有限输入电阻影响。
explanation.en: Input resistance rises from 100 to 200 kilohms, so head current falls from 30 to 15 microamps and deflection from 60% to 30%. The new range still reads 3 V. A real source may also respond to the meter’s finite input resistance.

question.zh: 灯不亮，为什么故障两端反而可能有较大电压？
question.en: Why can a fault show a large voltage while the lamp stays dark?

lead.zh: 在同一电路逐段接入有限内阻电压表，区分电压、测量电流和灯丝电流。
lead.en: Probe one loaded circuit and distinguish voltage, meter current and filament current.

principle.zh: 近乎断路的接触承担大部分电压；电压表跨接后又形成一条微小电流路径。有电压不能证明灯丝有足够工作电流。
principle.en: A nearly open contact takes most of the voltage. The parallel voltmeter creates a small current path; voltage alone does not establish sufficient filament current.

question.zh: 电池有电压，闭合开关两端电压很小，灯座外侧接近电源电压，能完全排除灯丝断裂吗？
question.en: The battery has voltage, the closed switch has almost none, and the socket terminals show nearly the source voltage. Can a broken filament be ruled out?

explanation.zh: 不能。在教材限定的候选故障中支持灯座接触不良；灯丝断裂也可能产生类似读数，需要更多独立检查。本模型只比较声明的单一故障。
explanation.en: No. Among the textbook’s candidate faults this supports bad socket contact, but a broken filament can produce a similar reading. Further independent checks are needed; this model compares only its declared single faults.

scientificBoundaries: 50µA/2kohm head and selected resistances are a teaching equivalent circuit, not a complete3007schematic.
All displayed currents/voltages are model calculations, not fixed historical observations.
Ohm shunts preserve one physical head; multiplier domain0.1–1000 is below the1500passive limit.
Needle stops clamp only geometry; overload current is not clipped.
Wire dashes indicate conventional current direction, not speed or quantity of individual carriers.
Human/filament use equivalent resistances; no medical inference/full thermal model. Diode exponential forward and leakage reverse model excludes breakdown.
